title: Restricted resolution and section identifications for the flat base-change map
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S\prime\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $X\prime=S\prime\times_S X$ and projections $f\prime,g\prime$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $F\prime=(g\prime)^*F$ [def-pc-module-pullback], and let $I,J$ be nonnegative injective resolutions of $F,F\prime$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For an open $V\subseteq S$ put $U=f^{-1}V$, $W=(g\prime)^{-1}U=(f\prime)^{-1}(g^{-1}V)$ and $h=g\prime|_W:W\to U$. A restricted-resolution section identification consists of an injective resolution of $F|_U$, an augmentation-preserving isomorphism to $I|_U$, and the corresponding isomorphism of additive section complexes to $I(U)$, whose components are restriction identification of sections composed with the resolution isomorphism; similarly for $F\prime|_W$ and $J(W)$. The flat-base-change open choices consist of these source and target identifications and the restricted $h$-map $\psi:F|_U\to h_*(F\prime|_W)$ of [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap], characterized by the commuting restriction-unit square for the original pullback adjunction unit $F\to g\prime_*F\prime$. The associated class maps use the resolution comparison on cohomology, exact evaluation, and the canonical cocycle-to-cohomology-sheaf map of [lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-presheaf].
